sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of PC and Console Video Games via Digital Stores

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction under the International Companies Act [CAP 222])
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – mixed legal system of English common law, French civil law, and customary law; the International Company statutory regime is modeled on English common-law precedent (BVI IBC model).
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral investment treaty currently in force for Vanuatu
No comprehensive double tax agreement network applicable; Vanuatu operates a no-income-tax regime for qualifying entities
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus – signed 14 June 2017, entered into force 13 December 2020
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (MSGTA) – signed 22 July 1993, as amended; active for Vanuatu

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222], as amended (including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2016 introducing beneficial ownership record-keeping and director/UBO register obligations); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 4 of 2014, as amended; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes; Financial Action Task Force Recommendations 10, 12, and 24-25; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [CAP 288].

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport pages of each beneficial owner holding 25% or more of the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not applicable – Vanuatu is not a contracting state to the Hague Apostille Convention 1961; the notarized document must be authenticated through the issuing country's foreign-ministry chain and legalized by a Vanuatu consular officer or an authorized legalization agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months) for each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed utility provider or regulated banking institution in the beneficial owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu non-Apostille state; certification chain per the issuing country's competent authorities followed by Vanuatu consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and banking history of the beneficial owner or funding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the beneficial owner's primary account relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (bank officer attestation notarized, then foreign-ministry certification and Vanuatu consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Directors of any corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry of the corporate owner's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (home jurisdiction registry certification, foreign-ministry authentication, then Vanuatu consular legalization; Hague Apostille accepted only if the home jurisdiction is an Apostille state and a certified apostille is affixed – VFSC agent will still require counsel verification)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, and beneficial owner against: (i) UN Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) US OFAC SDN List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) UK HM Treasury sanctions list; and (v) Vanuatu domestic targeted financial sanctions maintained under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 4 of 2014. PEP status determination is required under FATF Recommendation 12, with enhanced due diligence for any PEP, negative-news monitoring, and ongoing transaction surveillance. Given the target business is a low-risk digital software publisher (ISIC 5820) with payout rails through Steam and PlayStation Store, standard customer due diligence applies, refreshed annually or upon any material change in ownership.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registry of International Companies (VFSC Online Corporate Registry; name clearance filings are made exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be in Latin/Roman characters and may be expressed in English or French, the official languages of Vanuatu; numerals, hyphens, commas, and spaces are permitted; scripts such as Cyrillic, CJK, or Arabic are not accepted and must be transliterated into Latin characters; the name must end with a mandatory suffix: Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Societe Anonyme, or accepted abbreviations (Ltd., Corp., Inc., S.A.); Bislama names may be accepted on a case-by-case basis if rendered in Latin script and satisfying the suffix rule.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant (acting through its licensed registered agent) may file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, setting out grounds and supporting evidence such as trademark certificates or letters of consent from an existing rights holder. If the Registrar upholds the refusal, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 28 days of the final administrative determination. A name reservation may be extended before expiry by filing the VFSC extension application and paying the statutory extension fee; the maximum continuous reservation period is 90 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is NOT permissible for the statutory registered office requirement. The International Company must maintain a physical registered office address in Vanuatu and engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent (International Companies Act [CAP 222], ss. 35-36). A virtual or non-physical address is acceptable only for operational functions of the business, such as the remote digital publishing head office; all statutory records, registers, and service-of-process points must reside at the physical Vanuatu address maintained by the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – approximately 5-15% per annum risk of unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent's premises by VFSC supervisors; the likelihood of an on-site inspection of the company's own operational premises is negligible (~2% per annum) because the target is a remote digital game publisher with no required bricks-and-mortar facility in Vanuatu.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation fee for International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registry of International Companies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory service fee per VFSC Schedule of Fees (approximately VUV 4,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation registration fee for International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Registry of International Companies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent retainer – first year (including statutory filing, corporate secretarial support, and compliance interface)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per standard Vanuatu IC corporate services agreement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office service – first year (physical address, statutory records custody, service of process handling)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Vanuatu International Company registered office services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/KYC customer due diligence review and compliance file preparation (per AMLCFT Act requirements)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark based on standard due diligence workload for a low-risk digital publisher

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party screening platform (e.g., World-Check or equivalent licensed vendor)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing per-name subscription and lookup fee charged by the screening data provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff applicable in the issuing jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu diplomatic or consular mission / authorized legalization service agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular fee schedule plus processing agency commission; Vanuatu is not an Apostille state

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified true copies of incorporation documents and company seal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certified document issuance and common seal production

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and electronic transmission of original legalized documents and executed governance records
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing international courier rate for secure document shipment to the registered agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act (Cap. 222), Part II (Incorporation), ss. 5-8 (Memorandum and Articles of Association), s. 12 (Registered Agent), s. 13 (Registered Office); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act (Cap. 263); VFSC Fees Regulations (Schedule).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registry of International Companies, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, filed with VFSC Form ICA-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company), Form ICA-2 (Consent of Registered Agent) and Registered Office Consent Letter
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222). The company must issue at least one share, which may be par or no-par and denominated in any currency. No escrow arrangement, capital duty, or bank confirmation is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers named in the Memorandum of Association are hereby allotted one Ordinary Share each in the share capital of the Company, such subscription being fully paid, and the register of members is ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company, located at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as identified in the application for incorporation, is adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed as Director, [Name] as Corporate Secretary and [Name] as Compliance Officer, each having consented to act. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute digital distribution agreements with Steam and PlayStation storefronts, and retain the registered agent. All acts are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and VFSC Name Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC - Registry of International Companies, Name Approval Unit (filed through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed names in order of preference through the licensed registered agent's e-filing channel. The Registry rejects names that are undesirable, identical, or confusingly similar to existing companies or that imply regulated activities (e.g., 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', 'securities') absent a VFSC license. Obtain the name-approval letter before proceeding to drafting.
required_dossiers: Three proposed company names with English spelling
Name reservation request letter signed by applicant
Corporate client intake form and identity of ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit alternative names or file a written reconsideration request to the VFSC Registry; a non-conflicting re-submission is processed within the same 2-day SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Notarization and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and a Notary Public qualified in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the M&A in accordance with the ICA Schedule, incorporating an object clause limited to software publishing, digital distribution, licensing of video games and related IT services. Finalize share capital and classes (e.g., 50,000 ordinary shares of USD 1 each). Subscribers and directors execute the M&A before a notary; the registered agent countersigns its consent to act.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (two originals)
Statement of share capital and shareholder allocation
Notarized passport copies of each subscriber and director
Consent of proposed registered agent (Form ICA-2)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry or notary queries the objects clause, restate the M&A by a subscriber resolution and re-execute before the notary at the applicant's cost; the corrected instrument is re-tendered to the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Online Corporate Registry portal (via mandated registered agent) or VFSC counter at Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent uploads Form ICA-1, the executed M&A, registered agent consent, registered office consent and pays the statutory fee (VT 25,000 standard; VT 35,000 same-day express, approximately USD 250). Verify that the registered office address is a street address in Vanuatu and that the agent's consent is current.
required_dossiers: Form ICA-1 signed by the subscriber(s)
Executed and notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form ICA-2 consent of registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a notice of query, the registered agent files a formal response and cure documentation within 14 days of the notice; incomplete capital or objects clauses are corrected by a subscriber resolution, after which the application is re-submitted with no additional fee unless a new name is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification of the M&A and payment, the Registrar allots the company number and issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the seal of the VFSC, evidencing the company's legal existence and tax-exempt character. The registered agent retrieves the certificate and assembles the statutory corporate kit: share certificates, share register, minute book and common seal; verify all particulars against the name-approval letter.
required_dossiers: Acknowledged delivery of VFSC Certificate of Incorporation
Corporate kit inventory signed by the director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error, the agent submits a written request to the VFSC Registry to reissue the corrected certificate; registry-originated errors are cured at no cost within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance, Authorizations and Settlement Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / sole Director, in conjunction with the VFSC registered agent and the Company's chosen correspondent bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or circulate a written resolution to adopt the First Board Resolution; issue share certificates, open the shareholder register, and approve the opening of a corporate foreign-currency bank account. Obtain a Certificate of Good Standing and the IC tax-exemption / non-residence letter for the Steamworks and PlayStation Partner on-boarding, and file the VFSC annual licence fee before each 30 June.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and corporate kit
First Board Resolution and director consents
Bank account application and banking references
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or storefront (Valve/PlayStation) requires economic substance or commercial background evidence, the director supplies the M&A object clauses, published portfolio, and the VFSC letter confirming the IC's tax-exempt status; supplementary submission normally cures the application within the SLA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial or manufacturing authority licence is triggered for ISIC 5820 digital publishing; reference only: Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Investment Promotion (MTIIP), Industry Division, Port Vila
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Required - digital game publishing via Steam and PlayStation stores is an unlicensed activity in Vanuatu; only a Port Vila Municipal Council Business Licence is required if a physical retail or billing office is opened

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Administrative Registration only - no physical plant, emissions or effluent; a Full EIA Report is not required under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap. 283] for pure digital publishing. DEPC registration of the office address is recommended for e-waste compliance.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC thresholds apply. IT and e-waste handling must meet the Waste Management (General) Regulations: segregation, licensed recycler for end-of-life hardware, and no open burning of electronic waste at any premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: Certificate of Fitness issued by the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services for the registered office premises (portable extinguishers, smoke alarms, evacuation plan). Structural: no special load certification for office use; building occupancy certificate from the Public Works Department if premises exceed standard office loads. Occupational: general workplace safety obligations under the Employment Act [Cap. 160] - no plant or dangerous-goods clearance applicable to software publishing.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu; corporate registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), official portal: https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Vanuatu International Company (IC) with the VFSC through a licensed registered agent, submitting constitutional documents and nominee/registered office details. Step 2: Obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and IC registry number; the IC is statutorily income-tax-exempt and is not issued a national income-tax TIN. Step 3: If the IC will charge Vanuatu value added tax (e.g. direct sales of digital games to consumers in Vanuatu) or voluntarily chooses VAT registration, file Form VAT-01 with VCIR and obtain a VAT registration number. Step 4: Maintain banking and payout documentation connected to the IC's registered name; no separate e-TIN is procured for non-resident owners.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu law does not operate a check-the-box classification regime. The International Company is statutorily exempt from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and exchange control. Available elections: (a) voluntary VAT registration for an IC that makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu, including imported digital services to Vanuatu residents; (b) election to issue statutory invoices under the Value Added Tax Act; (c) no hybrid mismatch or conduit-election mechanisms apply because Vanuatu imposes no income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 249], administered by Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue; no separate national sales or goods-and-services tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover; a non-resident digital-service supplier is also required to register with VCIR if it makes taxable supplies to Vanuatu consumers above the threshold, with voluntary registration permitted.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is currently in force in Vanuatu. Taxpayers must issue and retain statutory VAT invoices in paper or PDF form, and preserve accounting and transaction records for six years. VCIR may require periodic electronic VAT returns and supporting schedules but does not operate a real-time government clearance gateway.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated when satisfactorily exported from Vanuatu within the statutory timeframe. Services supplied to a non-resident and performed wholly outside Vanuatu, including software/game rights licensing, Steam Valve and PlayStation Network publisher payouts, digital store distribution commissions, and offshore promotional services, qualify as zero-rated exports; services consumed in Vanuatu by local consumers are taxable at 12.5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed with Vanuatu Customs under the Customs Act, including the unique consignment reference
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical exportation from Vanuatu; for digital services, platform payout statements and delivery logs substitute for transport documents
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer confirmation matching the export consideration in VUV or foreign currency
Steam_Valve_Payout and PlayStation_Store_Payout statements, publisher agreements, royalty calculations, and user-location evidence demonstrating that the gaming service was supplied to non-residents
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no statutory exchange-control or fixed currency-repatriation deadline; the 180-day figure reflects the cross-border banking and anti-money-laundering settlement benchmark applicable to Steam and PlayStation store payouts. Under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 249], a false or fraudulent zero-rating claim is subject to VCIR audit: civil penalties of up to 100% of the tax shortfall plus interest, criminal fines up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment for up to five years, and retrospective clawback of zero-rated refunds, input credits, and the IC's tax-exempt privileges, including revocation of the VFSC international company licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), constituted under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125], is the monetary authority and banking supervisor for the Vatu (VUV); the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately licenses International Companies and financial dealers under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu is fully convertible across both current and capital accounts. Vanuatu maintains no exchange-control statute and imposes no restrictions on holding foreign-currency accounts, entering FX contracts, or repatriating profits and capital; the International Companies Act expressly authorizes ICs to transact in any currency. The VUV is stabilized through an RBV-managed basket/SDR peg with USD as the predominant intervention currency. Profit remittance from an IC is free of withholding tax and requires no RBV or VFSC approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts; digital game-publishing proceeds from Steam and PlayStation may be retained 100% in USD (or any foreign currency) in Vanuatu bank accounts and deployed abroad without declaration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD/VUV multi-currency); Capital Escrow not applicable (no minimum capital requirement under Cap 222)
Operational Account (USD/VUV); Capital Escrow not applicable
Operational Account (USD/EUR/VUV); Capital Escrow not applicable
Retail-facing account; not structured for offshore IC treasury operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary account-institution rail. Major EU/UK EMI providers generally decline VU-incorporated offshore ICs based on jurisdiction-restriction policies or impose restricted-use accounts pending 90-day operational history; where accepted, onboarding requires VFSC good-standing certificates, complete director KYC, and audited revenue evidence. A licensed Vanuatu bank account with a USD correspondent remains the mandatory primary rail; EMIs are viable only as secondary collection nodes for Steam/PlayStation receivables where the EMI maintains a direct USD account and publishes entity-level due-diligence acceptance policies for Pacific offshore jurisdictions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) and BSP Vanuatu generally require at least one director or ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-branch interview with original identification documents; no fully remote account opening exists for foreign-owned ICs. BRED Bank Vanuatu permits remote/offsite verification for directors domiciled in the EU, Australia, or New Zealand using apostilled corporate documents, notarized ID, and video-call confirmation. Effective mitigation: appoint a Vanuatu-resident director or use ANZ's cross-border staff-assisted verification desks in Sydney/Auckland to complete the single in-person interview requirement without a separate Port Vila trip.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction risk: historical FATF/EU listing status of Vanuatu triggering automatic enhanced due diligence (EDD) at the bank's correspondent panel
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current VFSC regulatory standing and good-standing certificate; FATF mutual evaluation or follow-up report extract showing completed action items; entity substance file (office lease, local director, employment records, bank-verified operational activity); audited financial statements for the last two fiscal years; written AML/CFT risk assessment of the IC and its revenue model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear UBO chain: nominee shareholders or trust structures concealing ownership behind the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed UBO and beneficial-ownership register filed under Vanuatu AML/CFT Act No. 29 of 2017; declaration of trust and registered-agent details; passport and proof of address for every direct or indirect 25%+ shareholder; lawyer/CPA-certified source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mixed or unverifiable revenue flow from Steam/PlayStation marketplaces flagged as unidentified incoming e-commerce
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed Valve Steamworks publisher agreement and Sony Interactive Entertainment publisher/partner agreement; 12-month payout statements from Valve and PlayStation Store; storefront sales analytics and royalty reconciliation ledger; game catalog registration and ISRC/title identifiers; IP assignment and development contracts; directors' annual declaration of the digital-publishing revenue model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fast-in/fast-out USD pattern: inbound royalty concentration followed by immediate wire-outs to developers and rights-holders, resembling pass-through or layering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bespoke royalty distribution schedule with matching invoice set; executed development and commercialization agreements naming each payee; deterministic Excel reconciliation model mapping inbound Steam/PlayStation settlements to outbound disbursements; payee KYB/KYC packs (registration, bank letter, tax-residency certificate); monthly treasury report provided to the bank's compliance team.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial paid-in capital and shareholder loans must route via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from an existing corporate or personal account of the beneficial owner; the narrative line must state 'Share Capital - [Entity Name]' or 'Intercompany Loan - [Entity Name]', and the receiving bank's transaction-purpose classification field should be completed as 'Share Capital / Paid-in Capital' or 'Intercompany Loan' where required by the ANZ/BSP onboarding system. No RBV approval or exchange-control permit is required; the receiving Vanuatu bank verifies a board resolution, certificate of incumbency, and source-of-funds evidence from the remitter, and posts the funds to a dedicated paid-in-capital sub-account recorded in the corporate register.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Steam (Valve) and PlayStation Store (Sony) settle net revenue by SWIFT MT103 into the IC's USD account at ANZ or BSP Vanuatu; inward settlement is received on Steam's monthly trailing cycle (approximately 30 days after month-end) and Sony's rolling 30-day net terms. Outbound disbursement to developers, rights-holders, and sub-publishers uses the same MT103 rail with a 'Royalty Payment' narrative and the bank's internal purpose classification, plus MT199/MT202 zero-balance sweeps between the operational and disbursement ledger accounts. Commercial letters of credit are not standard in game publishing; bank-guaranteed MT103 with matched invoice and the deterministic revenue-split report constitutes the acceptable clearing rail for high-value disbursements, with same-day or T+1 onward settlement using bank-internal sweeps to eliminate float leakage.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV FX forwards (maximum 12-month tenor) with ANZ, BSP, or BRED authorized dealer desks
USD/VUV cross-currency swaps and FX rollover/swaps under ISDA Master Agreements with licensed counterparties (no derivative-use restriction applies to ICs under Cap 222)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV executed via Singapore or Taipei counterparties to hedge basket-peg exposure where onshore deliverability is limited
Plain-vanilla FX options (USD call / VUV put) with bank counterparties within approved credit lines
Multi-currency deposit offset and borrowing arrangements providing a natural hedge of USD receivables against VUV-denominated operating costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Maintenance Fee for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Company Registry Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; registered agents normally require funds to be remitted 30 days before the anniversary date. Payment is accepted up to the due date without late penalty.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts incremental monetary penalties applied by VFSC, generally calculated as a percentage of the unpaid annual fee for each month of arrears. Continued non-payment beyond approximately three months may result in administrative strike-off and loss of legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Financial Statements Submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); no public filing is required.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable under the International Companies Act — no annual return and no financial statement filing is required for an International Company.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No annual return filing sanction applies. Failure to maintain the registered agent and registered office as required, however, may expose the company to administrative discontinuance or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit thresholds apply to an International Company under the International Companies Act. An external audit is not mandatory unless the company holds a VFSC financial services licence or such audit is required by its registered agent, bank, or contractual stakeholders.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is prescribed. If voluntary financial statements are prepared, IFRS is commonly adopted; local or international assurance standards may be referenced by the appointed auditor.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Companies are not subject to a public annual UBO filing. Nonetheless, the registered agent must obtain and maintain current beneficial ownership information under Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations. The registered agent customarily issues an annual compliance questionnaire requesting confirmation of ownership, directorship, and shareholding transfers; any transfer during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members and communicated to the registered agent to refresh due diligence records.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - 6,000 per engagement; not required for a standard International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; the International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from all income, profit, capital gains, distribution, and withholding taxes under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent statutory exemption for International Companies; no tax holiday application is required since the headline CIT rate is nil; the only recurring fiscal burden is the fixed annual government fee administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the licensed registered agent's fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. Recurring compliance is limited to (a) the IC Annual Government Fee remittance and (b) the registered agent's annual compliance and beneficial-ownership confirmation, both lodged through the VFSC e-Registry portal (https://vfsc.vu) by the licensed registered agent; non-resident beneficial owners cannot file directly and must instruct the agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — the annual government fee is due on the anniversary of incorporation; the registered agent must complete the beneficial-ownership verification on a calendar-year cycle; there are no quarterly CIT instalments or provisional tax payments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The IC annual government fee and agent confirmation are due on the anniversary date of the certificate of incorporation (no statutory extension); any change in directors, shareholders, or beneficial owners must be notified to the registered agent within 30 days of the change.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 1 — Registered Office Address (IC Act s. 96)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent; the statutory registers (directors, shareholders, charges) must be kept at this address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must provide a verified mailing address and consent to the registered office for service of process; a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and VFSC accreditation details of the registered agent who accepts statutory responsibility for the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident owner must execute a client agreement with the VFSC-licensed agent and complete standard customer due diligence (CDD), including source of funds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 3 — Directors and Shareholders Register Location
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming where the register of directors and the register of shareholders are physically maintained in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No public filing of director/shareholder details occurs; the register remains confidential but must be physically available at the registered office for lawful inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of the ultimate beneficial owner(s) of the IC, including ownership percentages, identity, and residence, retained by the registered agent under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 8 of 2014.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident UBOs must submit notarised identification, a reference, and an annual reaffirmation; material changes trigger a fresh filing within 30 days.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 5 — Tax-Exempt Status Election / Nil Income Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: An optional declaration confirming that the IC is engaged in permitted international activities and claims the statutory exemption from Vanuatu income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration may be requested by foreign payors (Valve/Steam, PlayStation/SIE) or overseas banks to evidence that no Vanuatu domestic tax is imposed before granting withholding relief.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 6 — Annual Government Fee Payment Reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC payment reference number evidencing settlement of the annual retention fee; non-payment triggers late-payment surcharge and strike-off procedures.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident owner must fund the registered agent before the anniversary date to guarantee timely payment and avoid administrative strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or non-payment of the annual government fee attracts a late-payment surcharge, automatic default fines accruing daily under the IC Act against both the company and every officer in default, and ultimate strike-off by the Registrar; the registered agent faces separate VFSC licence suspension or revocation for systemic non-filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no domestic dividend withholding tax; distributions of an International Company are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes regardless of the residence of the shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu's DTA network is extremely limited, with the Australia–Vanuatu DTA serving as the principal treaty. Protocol: (1) confirm that the payor's source jurisdiction has a treaty or unilateral domestic relief in force with Vanuatu; (2) apply to the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) evidencing Vanuatu residence and beneficial ownership; (3) submit the TRC together with the relevant relief certificate (US W-8BEN-E, OECD LOB self-declaration, or Australian residency declaration) to the payor; (4) ensure the IC maintains sufficient substance in Vanuatu to withstand treaty-shopping and limitation-on-benefits scrutiny.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on both royalty and interest payments (no Vanuatu withholding-tax legislation exists for outbound payments). Treaty rates: subject to the limited DTA network; the Australia–Vanuatu DTA applies arm's-length attribution and caps source taxation of royalties and interest at conventional OECD rates, commonly within the 0–15% band depending on beneficial ownership.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu enacts no statutory transfer-pricing, Local File, or Master File regime because no corporate income tax exists. Prudent group-level benchmark: maintain OECD-aligned contemporaneous documentation where annual related-party transactions exceed VUV 120,000,000 (approximately USD 1,000,000) or where any CFC, permanent establishment, or PE-attribution assertion is credible in the Steam/PlayStation market jurisdictions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 applies only to ICs carrying on a 'relevant activity' — banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, holding-company, or IP-holding business. Pure Steam/console publishing without material in-house IP ownership generally falls outside the enumerated relevant activities; however, the IC must still demonstrate genuine registered office, licensed agent, board decision-making, and books and records in Vanuatu to rebut foreign PE/CFC and treaty-abuse challenges, particularly where US/EU digital-storefront revenue is booked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Sham Offshore Residence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Central management and control (board meetings, treasury, Steam/Valve contracting, PlayStation/SIE negotiations, and developer-relations functions) is exercised in Australia, the USA, Japan, or Europe while representing to tax authorities and payment aggregators that the IC is a Vanuatu tax resident and the economic owner of the publishing revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no CIT-evasion penalty in the absence of income tax, but the source jurisdiction applies full anti-avoidance consequences: CFC inclusion in the parent's high-tax state, PE attribution of the publishing margins, back-taxes with interest, penalties of up to 200% of the avoidance amount in major OECD jurisdictions, and revocation of the IC's certificate by the VFSC; information is exchangeable under AEOI/EOIR channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false residence or beneficial-ownership declarations face civil restitution of the avoided foreign tax, accounting disqualification, travel bans pending criminal investigation, and custodial sentences for tax fraud; the Vanuatu corporate veil is pierced where the IC is shown to be a pure conduit, exposing personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a mere branded mailbox with no operational registered office, no VFSC-licensed agent actively engaged, no board minutes or decision-making in Vanuatu, fabricated or missing registers, and no books and records physically available in the jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration under the IC Act [Cap. 222]; reinstatement only on payment of all arrears and penalties; where a relevant activity is caught by the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, statutory monetary penalties apply to the company and its officers, with asset forfeiture upon final strike-off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent are jointly and severally liable for incorrect or absent records; in fraud scenarios the veil of incorporation is pierced, enabling civil recovery against personal estates, enforcement through Vanuatu's courts, and imprisonment of officers in the wilful-default category.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT and Beneficial Ownership Compliance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain the beneficial-ownership register with the registered agent, reintroduction of bearer-share practices, failure to report suspicious Steam/PlayStation payout flows, incomplete CDD on non-resident UBOs, and deliberate opacity toward the VFSC in the context of Vanuatu's FATF enhanced-monitoring obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary fines and criminal penalties under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 8 of 2014 and its amendments; licence revocation for the registered agent; VFSC freezing orders on the IC's accounts; and FATF countermeasures, including severe correspondent-banking restrictions that impair legitimate disbursements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face criminal prosecution, fines, and imprisonment terms prescribed by the AML/CFT Act; travel bans, account restraint orders, and confiscation of proceeds are routinely applied to individuals during investigation of a non-compliant IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Treaty and Withholding Abuse in Digital Storefront Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming reduced or zero withholding on Steam/Valve or PlayStation/SIE payouts by presenting a Vanuatu TRC and W-8BEN-E while the publishing operation lacks genuine beneficial ownership in Vanuatu; or concealing US-source royalty-type revenue where no US–Vanuatu DTA exists, causing incorrect reliance on a 0% withholding assumption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Source-country disallowance of treaty relief, 30% US statutory withholding recapture on reportable US-source proceeds, interest and late-payment penalties, CFC inclusion of the recaptured revenue, and potential referral of the IC and its officers to the VFSC for licence and registration review.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for fraudulent treaty claims arises as civil restitution of the full under-withheld amount plus statutory penalties; criminal tax-fraud prosecution may produce custodial sentences, director disqualification, and cross-border enforcement through mutual legal assistance treaties.
